model_details.model_description: Qwen3-TTS is Alibaba's open-source text-to-speech series, available in 0.6B and 1.7B '12Hz' checkpoints across three variants: CustomVoice (built-in speakers steered by a natural-language 'instruct' property for emotion/style), VoiceDesign (free-form natural-language voice descriptions, 1.7B only), and Base (3-second reference-audio voice cloning). CustomVoice/VoiceDesign 'voices' are configurable Custom Voice Presets (speaker + instruct + language) editable from this settings page. Base-model voice cloning uses .wav + matching .reference.txt pairs dropped into the engine's voices folder. Requires the 'qwen-tts' pip package. Output is mono WAV.
